name: ADK LLM Auditor
description: ADK fact-checking agent that extracts claims from an LLM answer, verifies them with web search and rewrites the answer to fix errors.
whatItDoes: It acts as a verification layer for text produced by language models: it isolates checkable statements, judges each against search results, reports a verdict with justification and can produce a corrected version. Useful for developers who want an automated grounding check.
howItWorks: A sequential pipeline of a critic agent, which uses Google Search to verify claims, and a reviser agent, which edits the original text according to the findings. It runs with the ADK CLI or web UI on Vertex AI.

requirements.name: GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT
requirements.description: Google Cloud project used for Vertex AI

requirements.name: GOOGLE_GENAI_USE_VERTEXAI
requirements.description: Set to true to route model calls through Vertex AI

requirements.name: uv
requirements.description: Python package manager used by the recipe
